name: Siebenschräm
summary: German trick-taking pub game where the winner of the last of four tricks wins the hand and all others lose lives.
rules_text: Played with 32-card Skat pack (10 high, then 9,8,7,A,K,Q,J low). 2-8 players, normally 4. Each starts with 7 marks (Schräm). Dealer deals 4 cards each, rest unused. Forehand leads any card, others must follow suit if able, else discard. Highest card of led suit wins trick; winner leads next. Whoever wins the fourth and last trick wins the hand. Hand value starts at 1. At any time a player may knock to raise value by 1 up to 7. After a knock, each opponent in clockwise order must declare stay or fold; folders immediately lose old value marks and discard. No player may knock twice in a row, and may not knock for more than his remaining marks, except from 2 may knock to 3. Knocking unseen before seeing cards allowed up to value 4. A player with 1 mark left (hammer/poor) must knock to 2 unseen. Losers of hand lose current value marks; winner loses none. Player who loses all 7 marks is out; last remaining wins.
